sources.title: Introducing LFM3: Every Modality for Specialized Intelligence
sources.snippet: LFM3 is Liquid AI's new open-weight model family: 2B-class text, vision, audio, omni, and decision models built to fine-tune and run fast on any device.

sources.title: Liquid AI Releases LFM3: 6 Open-Weight 2B-Class Multimodal Models
sources.snippet: Liquid AI has released LFM3, its new generation of Liquid Foundation Models. Liquid AI LFM3 is a family of 6 open-weight, 2B-class models built on one shared backbone. The family covers text, vision, audio, omni and decision tasks. Every model can be fine-tuned on a single GPU.

sources.title: LFM3 - lmstudio.ai
sources.snippet: About LFM3 Liquid AI builds small models designed for specialization and on-device deployment. LFM3 brings a new tri-hybrid architecture and a shared backbone for text, vision, audio, omni, and decision models. The model featured here, LFM3-VL-2B, combines the LFM3 language backbone with an in-house vision encoder for text, image, and video input.
